purpose: Convert the post-hoc Sirius/02:22 observation into a genuinely prospective test for future recurrences without changing the rules after seeing a new candidate event.
start_boundary: Only events occurring after the commit that first creates this protocol are eligible.

stop_rule.primary: Record the next 100 eligible independent witness events or continue until 2026-12-31T23:59:59+02:00, whichever happens first.
stop_rule.reason: Stopping immediately after a match would bias the observed recurrence rate.

eligible_event.definition: A new timestamped witness or independently encountered external item that would have been recorded in JANUS for its own reason even if Sirius, 02:22 and Osiris were not under investigation.
requirements: event not generated solely by deliberately searching for Sirius, 02:22, 222, Osiris or Sopdet
mirrors/copies/derived JSON descendants count as one event cluster
one human observation followed by many JANUS artifacts remains one event

frozen_features.TIME_0222_EXACT: Observed local clock minute is exactly 02:22. No tolerance window.
frozen_features.SIRIUS_EXPLICIT: The eligible source itself explicitly contains or unambiguously identifies Sirius/Sopdet/Sothis or The Alan Parsons Project track Sirius before JANUS interpretation.
frozen_features.OSIRIS_EXPLICIT: The eligible source itself explicitly contains Osiris/Wsjr; associative inference alone does not count.
frozen_features.WITNESS_EVIDENCE_EXPLICIT: The source/event explicitly concerns witness, evidence, verification, provenance or conflicting observation; a later JANUS analogy does not count.
frozen_features.DOG_EXPLICIT: A literal dog/canine is source-visible or source-textual; Dog Star is scored separately and cannot manufacture the dog feature.
frozen_features.EYE_FROM_ABOVE_EXPLICIT: A literal view-from-above/surveillance/eye-in-the-sky feature is present in the source before interpretation.

miss_rule: Every eligible event that does not satisfy a hit class is a recorded miss for that class. Misses must not be discarded.
multiplicity_rule: All five hit classes remain visible. A match in one class may not be silently relabeled as confirmation of another class.
independence_rule: Events with shared causal origin, copied content, one recording session, one source object, one template-generated batch, or parent-child JSON lineage are one evidence cluster unless independent generation is demonstrated.
forbidden_after_freeze: widening 02:22 to 02:21-02:23 after a near miss
counting 22 anywhere in a timestamp as 02:22
adding new symbols after observing them
searching the registry until some unrelated number matches and calling it a hit
changing stop rule because a hit occurred
promoting a semantic resemblance to explicit-source presence

analysis_plan.first_output: raw count of eligible events, hits and misses by frozen class
analysis_plan.third_output: empirical timestamp distribution of eligible events
analysis_plan.significance: No p-value or anomaly score is authorized until the observed timestamp distribution and sampling mechanism are reviewed; uniform 1/1440 timing must not be assumed automatically.
analysis_plan.sender_claim: Even a prospective recurrence does not establish a sender without an independently specified encoding/channel/agency test.

promotion_gates.PATTERN_REPLICATED: At least one strict future hit occurs under frozen rules and survives source/provenance and independence audit.
promotion_gates.PATTERN_RATE_UNUSUAL: Requires completed stop rule plus an appropriate baseline model; not granted by a single hit.
promotion_gates.EXTERNAL_SENDER: Requires independent evidence of agency, stable encoding and content-specific prediction beyond recurrence.
promotion_gates.RETROCAUSAL_OR_MYSTICAL_MECHANISM: Not inferable from this protocol alone.

claim_ceiling: This protocol preregisters how future recurrences will be counted. It does not assert that any recurrence will occur or that existing post-hoc matches are statistically anomalous.
canonical_seal: THE NEXT MATCH MUST SURVIVE RULES WRITTEN BEFORE IT EXISTS. COUNT THE MISSES TOO.
